P: Citi，（f.） [From ci，cināti，to heap up] a heap，made of bricks J.VI，204 （city-avayata-piṭṭhikā）．See also cetiya．（Page 265）
O:
citi：စိတိ
စု = ဇာနနေ-သိခြင်း၌။ စိနေ္တတိ၊ စိန္တယတိ။

citī：စိတီ
ဘူ = သညာဏေ-သိခြင်း၌။ စေတတိ။

ciṭiciṭāyati.p: [Ciṭiciṭa+āya+ti] (kri) CL=10 Makes a sound of  'Ciṭ, Ciṭ or Chit, Chi.'; Sounds 'Chit, Chit'. See-cicciṭāyati.
a: စိဋိစိဋာယတိ(ကြိ)
[စိဋိစိဋ+အာယ+တိ]
စိဋ်စိဋ်-ဖျစ်ဖျစ်-ဟူသော အသံကိုပြု၏၊ စိဋ်စိဋ်-ဖျစ်ဖျစ်-မြည်၏။ စိစ္စိဋာယတိ-ကြည့်။

DOP: ciṭiciṭāyati pr. 3 sg. [ onomat.; BHS ciṭiciṭāyati], sputters, makes a sputtering sound ; Vin I 225, 27 (seyyathā pi nāma phālo divasaṃ santatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati ~āyati saṃdhūpāyati sampadhūpāyati) = S I 169, 8 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se viciṭāyati viṭiciṭāyati) = Sn p. 15, 12 (Pj II 154, 25 : cicciṭāyati ~āyatī ti evaṃ saddaṃ karoti); A I 127, 7 (tiṇḍukālātaṃ kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭitaṃ bhīyosomattāya cicciṭāyati ~āyati; Mp II 198, 4 foll. : taṃ hi jhāyamānaṃ pakatiyā pi papaṭikāyo muñcantaṃ cicciṭāti ( or cicciṭā ti) ciṭiciṭā ti saddaṃ karoti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se ciciṭāti ciciṭā ti) = Pp 36, 32 ; Mil 258, 28 (imaṃ udakaṃ aggimhi tappamānaṃ cicciṭāyati ~āyati saddāyati bahuvidhaṃ, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se pipidāyati paṭipidāyati); Thī-a 6, 17 (cicciṭāyati ~āyati).
NCP: pr. 3 sg. | ci.tici.taayati makes the sound “citi-citi”; sputters, makes a sputtering sound.
